verdict.rationale: VLP Law Group is a distributed law firm offering legal services such as fintech regulatory, venture, IP, privacy and employment counsel. It is not a software platform that holds user data, so self-service bulk export in open formats is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows it ships any data-export capability that would make the axis apply; the privacy-practice evidence is legal advice about data laws, not a product export feature.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
